name: intro
arrangement: Gentle steel-string acoustic guitar picks the syncopated root motif, paired with a soft felt upright piano chord pad. Muted room ambiance with low-volume mechanical clock ticks tucked into the stereo field.

name: verse_1
arrangement: Upright bass enters with warm, rounded root-fifth movement. Subtle wooden rim-clicks mark beat three alongside dry acoustic guitar arpeggios, leaving vocal space wide and dry.

name: pre_1
arrangement: A soft brushed snare rolls in; reversed piano swells create harmonic tension as the bass walks stepwise from E to A beneath the climbing pre-chorus lines.

name: chorus_1
arrangement: Full rhythm section enters with punchy, dampened kick and brushed snare. Open acoustic strumming wide in the stereo image supports a melodic electric guitar answering line after each vocal phrase.

name: turnaround
arrangement: Acoustic guitar and bass strip back down to a four-bar breath. Clean electric guitar plays a single-note echo of the main hook with tasteful analog delay.

name: verse_2
arrangement: Light sixteenth-note shaker layered with wooden rim-clicks. Bass plays a more syncopated counter-rhythm against muted electric guitar stabs on upbeats.

name: pre_2
arrangement: Dynamic build with crescendoing floor tom patterns, doubled acoustic strums, and expressive bass glides pushing into the second chorus entry.

name: chorus_2
arrangement: Full instrumentation with prominent electric counter-melody, doubled acoustic guitars, driving bass line, and crisp drum fills reinforcing chorus recall.

name: bridge
arrangement: Sudden drop to near-silence. Sustained piano chords modulate briefly with ambient guitar volume swells and sub-bass resonance, leaving the introspective vocal completely exposed.

name: final_chorus
arrangement: Climactic dynamic peak with layered backing hums, ringing open-string guitars, rhythmic drum accents, and soaring top-end electric lead fills before a sudden half-time cadence.

name: outro
arrangement: Drums cut out; fingerpicked acoustic guitar repeats the opening progression alongside slow-decaying piano notes, concluding on an unresolved Bmadd9 with soft ticking fading into silence.
